profile_text: With a strong presence in the wholesale and retail trade sector, this Düsseldorf-based firm has achieved significant growth, increasing its workforce by 64.6% to 135 employees in 2024. As a specialist in the repair of motor vehicles and motorcycles, its success can be attributed to its expertise in providing high-quality services, likely driven by the increasing demand for vehicle maintenance and repair in the German market. This growth trajectory has earned the company a "Scaler" category designation, indicating its potential for continued expansion.
